label: bucket-integrity
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM client_dev.ashlar_entropy_20261006_r86.bucket_part_r164 VERSION AS OF 4 WHERE lookup_hash IS NULL OR NOT(lookup_hash RLIKE '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') OR lookup_bucket IS NULL OR lookup_bucket<>(cast(pmod(cast(conv(substr(lookup_hash,1,15),16,10) AS BIGINT),64) AS INT))
